headline: Microsoft launches unified Copilot super app, drops Copilot+ PC label
summary: Microsoft unveiled a redesigned Copilot "super app" combining chat, coding and agents into one workspace, adding support for third-party frontier models and rebranding its Scout assistant as Autopilot. Pricing for the new usage-based model is still described as evolving. Separately, Microsoft has quietly dropped the "Copilot+ PC" branding from its newest Surface laptops.
